title: Every Nonrecursive Many-One Degree Contains Either One or Infinitely Many Finite-One Degrees
summary: This paper proves that every nonrecursive many-one degree contains either exactly one or infinitely many finite-one degrees. This gives a negative answer to Open Question 2 of Richter, Stephan, and Zhang~\cite[p.~17]{RSZ}. Earlier work established that, for almost every $A\subseteq\N$ with respect to the standard product measure on $2^\N$, the degree $[A]_{\m}$ contains an infinite antichain of finite-one degrees~\cite{Cintioli}. Thus the question had already received an almost-sure negative answer; the present theorem settles it for every nonrecursive many-one degree.
